hints.title: Extracting Free Time Gaps
hints.text: Compute the durations of all free time intervals around and between meetings.

hints.title: Merging Intervals by Relocation
hints.text: Rescheduling up to k meetings allows merging up to k + 1 consecutive intervals of free time.

hints.title: Sliding Window over Gaps
hints.text: Use a sliding window of size k + 1 over the gap array to find the maximum possible continuous free time.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Extracts gaps between meetings and computes maximum sum of k + 1 consecutive gaps with sliding window.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual meeting shifts is redundant since packing k meetings merges k + 1 gaps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores n + 1 gaps in an array for linear sliding window processing.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that rescheduling k meetings merges k + 1 consecutive gaps and applies sliding window.
